prior_defect: The previous 74-object link reused 36 ROCclr/backend objects from a different source build.

title_lifecycle_audit.entry: _start registers loader teardown, _fini, shell-exit probe and title finalizer before _init, then calls main and exit.
title_lifecycle_audit.tls: The title forwards __cxa_thread_atexit_impl to the SDK ps5___cxa_thread_atexit_impl; the rebuilt ROCclr pthread-key adapter owns and destroys each adopted current-thread object.
title_lifecycle_audit.watchdog: A 30-second watchdog spans hipInit and hipGetDeviceCount and is joined before the PASS record.
title_lifecycle_audit.finalizer: The finalizer checks successful main completion, nonterminal device state, balanced allocations and queues, and destroyed gate after upstream static teardown.
title_lifecycle_audit.exit: The existing shell-exit probe checks main return, callback/static-destructor order, application _fini, flushed log, and a single shell-exit request; a failed check quarantines the title for controller close.
title_lifecycle_audit.results: The title reads /app0/results-dir.txt, requests the bundled Lapy filesystem capability, and writes an exclusive result log under the configured directory.

limits: Offline link, conversion, package and source audits cannot prove pre-main behavior or the public API result on PS5.
The title remains an isolated candidate; a separate independent review and fresh one-use D/E controls are required before .40.
This package does not include the separate public SVM memory bridge or prove public HIP allocation, stream, or kernel calls.
